_doc: Catalogue of interactive figure types. Authors write ':::widget <type>' blocks with 'key: value' lines; tools/build.js validates them against this file. Param types: expr (expression in 'vars', plus slider names), exprs (';'-separated exprs), cexpr (complex expression in z), num (number or constant expression like pi/2), int, bool, range ('min, max'), enum (one of 'values'), str, list (';'-separated strings), points ('x,y; x,y'), sliders ('a=1:-3:3:0.1; b=…' = value:min:max[:step]), matrix ('a,b; c,d' rows separated by ';'). Every type also accepts 'title' (str) and 'caption' (inline markup, shown under the figure).

plot.title: Function plotter
plot.desc: Graphs of one or more functions of x with optional parameter sliders, shading, marked points and a draggable tangent.

f.desc: functions of x separated by ';' (sliders' names may appear)

labels.desc: legend labels (TeX allowed), one per function

shade.desc: shade under the first function between these x values

between.desc: with shade: fill between the first two functions instead

tangent.desc: x0: draggable tangent line to the first function

plot.example:
f: sin(a*x); a*x
sliders: a=1:0.2:3
x: -2pi, 2pi
piticks: true
plot.zh_desc: 一个或多个关于 x 的函数图像，可加参数滑块、阴影、标记点和可拖动的切线。

distribution.title: Probability distributions
distribution.desc: PMF/PDF and CDF of a named distribution with parameter sliders, P(a ≤ X ≤ b) shaded, mean ± sd, and an optional normal approximation.

params.desc: initial parameters, e.g. 'n=10, p=0.3' or 'mu=0, sigma=1'

distribution.example:
dist: binomial
params: n=20, p=0.3
a: 4
b: 8
normal: true
distribution.zh_desc: 常见分布的概率质量函数/密度函数和分布函数，带参数滑块、P(a ≤ X ≤ b) 阴影、均值 ± 标准差，可叠加正态近似。

graph.title: Graphs and graph algorithms
graph.desc: A draggable graph and a step-by-step algorithm: BFS, DFS, Dijkstra, Prim, Kruskal, topological sort, Euler circuit or greedy colouring.
graph.example:
nodes: A; B; C; D; E
edges: A-B:4; A-C:1; C-B:2; B-D:1; C-D:5; D-E:3
algorithm: dijkstra
start: A
graph.zh_desc: 可拖动的图及逐步演示的算法：广度优先、深度优先、迪杰斯特拉、普里姆、克鲁斯卡尔、拓扑排序、欧拉回路或贪心着色。

venn.title: Venn diagrams
venn.desc: Two or three sets; the regions of a set expression (∪ ∩ \ ′ or | & - ') are shaded; type a new expression.
venn.zh_desc: 两个或三个集合；对集合表达式（∪ ∩ \ ′）对应的区域着色，也可输入新的表达式。

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.desc: A short list of dated events on one axis. Move the year and the window. Negative years are BCE. The integer 0 is not a historical year.
timeline.zh_desc: 一条轴上的一短串有年代的事件。移动年份和窗口。负年份为公元前。整数 0 不是历史年份。

start.desc: first year on the axis; negative means BCE

events.desc: year,label items separated by semicolons; the label may contain further commas

window.desc: half-width of the highlight, in years

series.title: Dated series
series.desc: Points the lesson supplies, each a year and a value. The cursor finds the nearest recorded year and does not invent a value in between.
series.zh_desc: 课文给出的点，每点是一个年份和一个数值。游标找到最近的有记录年份，不在两点之间编造数值。
series.example:
points: 1801,8892536; 1851,17927609; 1901,32527843
ylabel: people, England and Wales
